episodes.title: The Athlete`s Pledge
episodes.synopsis: The Chubu Block championship arrives, bringing Inori her chance to qualify for the All-Japans Novice Contest. At the venue, Inori is overwhelmed with emotion at finally being in the place she has always dreamed of. There, she meets the other Novice A skaters, but the atmosphere shifts when former Olympian Riina Kojoh appears.

episodes.title: My Cards
episodes.synopsis: A game of musical chairs for the top five spots at the All-Japans begins. With one of the most talented skaters of their generation absent from the competition, everyone now has a real chance at winning.

episodes.title: The Queen`s Leap
episodes.synopsis: The second group, including Inori, take their turn at the championship. With only three skaters to go, Yuna Yagi steps onto the ice. Despite promising her coach she will stick to their planned program, she finds herself hesitating mid-performance.

episodes.title: Ascendance
episodes.synopsis: It is Inori's turn to step onto the ice. Tsukasa has crafted a strategy that plays to Inori's strengths, with a trump card for the final stretch.

episodes.title: Beacon
episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa finds himself in an unexpected situation skating alongside legends Jun Yodaka and Shinichiro Sonidori. As he watches Jun move across the ice with breathtaking skill, something stirs within him.

episodes.title: Intensive Training
episodes.synopsis: Inori joins an intensive training session with the Chubu Block competitors heading to the All-Japans. Reuniting with Hikaru and the other skaters, she quickly realises there is a gap in her abilities that she had not anticipated.

episodes.title: The Frozen Lake
episodes.synopsis: A training session with jump specialist Kakeru Uobuchi brings remarkable results, and Tsukasa is so impressed he decides to invest in his own harness equipment. He brings it to the ice rink intending to help Inori master jumps.

episodes.title: Hot Passion
episodes.synopsis: Inori and Tsukasa arrive at Niigata skating rink in the early morning, seeking Coach Uobuchi's guidance. After observing Inori's skating, Uobuchi presents them with an unexpected proposition.

episodes.title: It Begins
episodes.synopsis: At the Niigata rink, Inori and Tsukasa cross paths with Miku Ahiru, a formidable competitor, along with her coach Kohei Kamogawa and choreographer Juna Shiratori, both former clubmates of Tsukasa's. When Inori speaks with Miku, she discovers something unexpected about her rival's future in skating. Meanwhile, Tsukasa finds himself confronting uncomfortable truths about his abilities as a coach. With the competition approaching, both Inori and Tsukasa face questions that could reshape their path forward.

info.title: Tokyo Godfathers
info.synopsis: Tre senza tetto trovano, in una magica vigilia di Natale, un bambino abbandonato nella spazzatura. Dopo qualche discussione decidono di riportarlo direttamente alla madre, senza passare per la polizia. Con i pochi indizi che hanno i disposizione, inizia una sgangherata ricerca, nella quale i protagonisti finiranno per confrontarsi con i propri passati…

info.title: Do You Like Big Girls?
info.synopsis: Sōta Tachibana è un freeter poliedrico che passa da un lavoro part-time all’altro, distinguendosi soprattutto per la sua bassa statura. La sua vita cambia quando la sorella maggiore Kaoru, alta quasi due metri, lo coinvolge come assistente nella squadra di pallavolo femminile dell’università di cui fa parte. Sōta si ritrova così a lavorare a stretto contatto con un gruppo di ragazze tutte molto alte, atletiche e dalla forte personalità, finendo per essere immerso in un ambiente completamente nuovo per lui. La sua presenza, così diversa da quella delle giocatrici, attira rapidamente la loro attenzione, dando vita a dinamiche vivaci e spesso imbarazzanti.

episodes.title: Do You Like "Big Girls"?
episodes.synopsis: Tall Kaori and short Sota are siblings by marriage. One day, commanded by Kaori, Sota becomes the dorm manager and coach for her university women's volleyball team. Among the members is Ayano, his first love, and they have an unexpected reunion! Sota begins living together with the club members as the dorm manager. But that night, he witnesses an unexpected side of Ayano, whom he's always admired...?!

episodes.title: The Target! All Eyes On Sota
episodes.synopsis: Kaori, who had suggested the date herself, becomes flustered upon learning that Sota and Ayano went to a hotel. Still, as Sota's sister, she tries to mediate between them... Meanwhile, Sakura, Kyoka, and Yuria, having heard the whole story, come up with a bizarre theory: Since they're also members of the girls' volleyball club like Ayano, they should have the right to do the same thing! And so, they begin seducing Sota!

episodes.title: Do You Like Tiny Girls Too?
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is present at the girls' dormitory, now with the club president, Sanae, who had been absent for a while due to family circumstances, returning to the volleyball club. Sanae, a libero specializing in defense, is petite despite being on the volleyball team, and Sota finds himself drawn to her, who is shorter than him. The group decides to hold a Genghis Khan party to celebrate Sanae's return and Sota's appointment as coach. But that night, an unexpected hint of romance awaited Sota!

episodes.title: The Cherry Blossom Season The Pure-Hearted Girl with Glasses
episodes.synopsis: Sakura is always full of jokes. One day, when Sota tells her that she'd be cute if she just acted normal, a certain memory resurfaces. Back in elementary school, Sakura, already tall for her age, played the clown while spending her days with her male friend, Takeshi. Eventually, they entered middle school and both joined the volleyball club. However, a rift gradually formed between Sakura, blessed with physique and talent, and Takeshi, who was not...

episodes.title: You Are The Grand Prize!
episodes.synopsis: One night, Kaori, wearing only her underwear, comes to Sota's room seeking help. Sota is shocked, but it turns out the club members were holding a strip mahjong tournament. With Kaori facing certain defeat, she makes a last-ditch effort to recruit Sota as her substitute player. The tournament's grand prize was... the right to do whatever they wanted with Sota?! Reluctant but needing to protect himself, Sota joins the game. Meanwhile, Kaori seems to have her own thoughts on the matter...

episodes.title: Kyoka's Top Secret
episodes.synopsis: Last night's events left Sota feeling awkward. Kaori forcefully tries to act like nothing happened, but Sota's words about Sanae stirs something within her. Amidst this, a secret about Kyoka is revealed?! While it was quietly known among the club members, the shock of it coming out causes Kyoka to flee. Mental care is also an important job for the dorm manager and coach... Sota hurriedly chases after her!

episodes.title: Go! Go! Julia!
episodes.synopsis: The gym gets double-booked by both the volleyball and basketball teams. They decide to settle it with a game, and the sport Julia proposes is none other than basketball?! There's no way they stand a chance against the basketball team at their own game, and naturally, the members voice their discontent. But Julia is strangely confident, and Sota decides to trust her. And so, the match between the volleyball team and basketball team begins!

episodes.title: Who Do You Really Like?
episodes.synopsis: The girls from the dorm head to the shopping district for supplies. They came to buy groceries, but Sota gets thoroughly swayed again by the members' self-indulgent, free-spirited actions. After much commotion, they manage to finish shopping and discover they can try their luck at a lucky draw. The grand prize is a pair of hot spring trip vouchers! Kaoru, concerned about Sanae and Sota's relationship, wins it and wants to give it to them, but...

episodes.title: A Valentine's Kiss
episodes.synopsis: Today is Valentine's Day! Kaoru and Kyoka, with their tall figure and short hair, are treated like princesses and receive chocolates from their female fans. Seeing this, Sanae and Ayano decide they want to make some for Sota too, and eventually the whole club ends up making homemade chocolates. Kaoru also hands Sota the chocolate she made herself. It contains something not found in ordinary family chocolates...

episodes.title: Let's Go on a Date!
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru couldn't shake the words Ayano had said to her on Valentine's Day night regarding her feelings for Sota. Then, in a sudden turn of events, Kaoru finds herself running out of the dorm in her nightclothes. Sota, who had followed her, invites her on a date. They go clothes shopping together, eat dinner, and drink out. But then, drunk, Kaoru declares she doesn't want to go home...!

episodes.title: The Witch of Toyohira
episodes.synopsis: The unexpected date with Sota begins. Fueled by alcohol, Kaoru ends up going into a hotel with him, reminiscing about their childhood. Tall and nicknamed the "Witch of Toyohira," Kaoru often protected the smaller, bullied Sota. Kaoru advised him that if he really fought back, things will work out—but that advice relied on Kaoru's own physique. What is the surprising suggestion Kaoru makes to Sota who has half-given up...?

episodes.title: Do You "Like" Big Girls?
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru and Sota both return to the dorm in the morning, in a mess—Kaoru hungover, Sota with facial injuries. Kaoru had almost no memory of the night, but vaguely recalls that something good had happened. Amidst this, in front of everyone, Julia eventually makes a remark that Kaoru likes Sota?! This happy harem story set in Hokkaido comes to an end for now!

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes On a New Position
episodes.synopsis: A few months into his appointment as the Liberion Order's special instructor, Beryl Gardenant is settling into his new life in the capital. One day, he's visited by Lucy and Ficelle, who ask him to become a temporary instructor at the Magic Institute. Beryl joins the sword magic course where Mewi is enrolled, witnesses Ficelle's teaching methods, and finds himself facing off against her...

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Watches Them Grow
episodes.synopsis: Beryl wrestles with teaching Ficelle - who is a terrible teacher - how to actually teach. Mewi struggles to fit in with her fellow students, but a conversation with Cindy at lunch hints at that beginning to change. At a small party, Beryl views both Mewi and Ficelle's growth with satisfaction. And then an unexpected disturbance rocks the Magic Institute.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees Himself in an Old Man
episodes.synopsis: Wolf-shaped shadows attack the teachers and magic is rendered useless on campus. Able to fight even without magic, Beryl and Ficelle force their way into the school in an effort to uncover the cause of the strange happenings. When shadow wolves appear in the cafeteria, Mewi and her classmates decide to confront them, despite their inexperience. Two battles unfold - so how will they end?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Returns Home
episodes.synopsis: A letter addressed to Beryl arrives from Beaden. Sent by his father Mordea, it urges him to return to the village for an annual event unique to the village. With the Magic Institute on summer break, Beryl invites Mewi to accompany him and Henblitz. Then Curuni invites herself along. It's the first time Beryl's been home since his move to the city. The next day, an unexpected confrontation occurs.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Lets Out a Roar
episodes.synopsis: Their mission to take down the saberboar begins. Curuni achieves her long-cherished goal of taking one down and realizes how much stronger she has become. Randrid makes full use of the skills he honed as an adventurer and puts his swordsmanship to good use. Impressed, Henblitz challenges him to a sparring match - which ignites something in the hearts of both Beryl and another swordsman.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces Off Against His Father
episodes.synopsis: With the saberboar threat eliminated, Beaden holds its annual festival. The friendship between Henblitz and Randrid grows, while Adel and Edel fuss over Mewi. Beryl watches it all and reflects on his own feelings over the years. Then Mordea arrives and the two head for the dojo. Can Beryl overcome the giant wall that is his father?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets an Invitation from Nobility
episodes.synopsis: A banquet is being held in the lands of the Margrave of Flumvelk, a region bordering Sphenedyardvania, and both Allucia and Beryl have been invited. The visit is also a chance to confirm the route the soon-to-be-wed Princess Salacia will take to her new home. Along the way, Beryl gives advice to a young knight. When he arrives at his destination, an unexpected reunion awaits him.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets a Marriage Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Shueste, the sister of Beryl's former student Warren, relentlessly pursues Beryl - but for a good reason. Seeing this upsets Allucia, Warren explains both his and Shueste's motives, and encourages Allucia to make her own move. Beryl's actions at the banquet leave Shueste even more smitten. Having finished their assignment, Beryl and Allucia head home - but face an unforseen encounter on the way.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Holy City
episodes.synopsis: Back in the capital, Beryl struggles to shake his guilt over Vesper's grave injuries, while Surena tries to cheer him up. The day of Princess Salacia's wedding draws near, and Beryl joins the escort detail. After a short reunion with Shueste and with the threat of an attack by the Verdapis Mercenary Company looming, they reach Dilmahakha, the holy city of Sphenedyardvania. But who is watching him?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees in the New Year
episodes.synopsis: Allucia and Gatoga visit Beryl at his lodgings in Dilmahakha, and Gatoga shows Beryl around the city. Once they're alone, Gatoga tells him what became of Rose. Back in Baltrain, Curuni and Ficelle put Mewi through special training, while Lucy and Ibroy meet in secret. The new year arrives, bringing Princess Salacia's wedding - and screams of terror ring out through the cathedral.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Flies into a Rage
episodes.synopsis: The Verdapis Mercenary Company bursts into the cathedral. Beryl moves to stop them, but Ibroy yells, "They're on our side!" Forced into an uneasy alliance, Beryl and the others escort the prince and princess safely to the palace. Along the way, Beryl's rage clashes with Hanoy's pride as a mercenary. But an even greater crisis engulfs the Holy City - caused by none other than Pope Morris himself.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home
episodes.synopsis: The masked White Maiden is revealed to be none other than Beryl's former student, Rose. Beryl and the White Maiden meet up with Allucia and Surena, who have successfully taken down the Chimera, and they head to back up the Verdapis Mercenary Company. There, they find Hanoy on the brink of defeat - and Pope Morris standing calmly before him. The final battle is about to begin.

info.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea (ITA)
info.synopsis: Dopo aver concluso la cerimonia di apertura della "Federazione del Regno dei Demoni di Tempest", Rimuru e i suoi compagni sono invitati dall’Imperatrice Celeste Hermesia della grande nazione elfica a visitare la sua isola privata. Mentre il gruppo si gode la sua breve vacanza, appare una donna misteriosa di nome Yura e, improvvisamente, avviene uno strano incidente sullo sfondo del mare azzurro sconfinato...

info.title: Vertex Force
info.synopsis: Akira vive una vita tranquilla insieme alla sorella maggiore Haruka e alla madre, che gestisce un caffè. La famiglia, tuttavia, nasconde un segreto: Haruka ha ereditato dal padre un potere chiamato "Engine" e lo tiene nascosto agli altri. Akira, d'altra parte, non ha ereditato il potere del padre e soffre di un complesso d'inferiorità a questo proposito. Nel frattempo, strani eventi iniziano a verificarsi in tutto il mondo.

episodes.title: Engine, Ignition
episodes.synopsis: When the global network is disrupted, Haruka must use a power inherited from her father to protect her family.

episodes.title: Vertex
episodes.synopsis: Just after Akira's hidden power reveals itself, two unfamiliar women appear before him.

episodes.title: Ardent Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Haruka and Akira depart for Hokkaido with Eleanor and Lala to find the fifth Vertex.

episodes.title: Brother and Sister
episodes.synopsis: On a deserted island, Lala devises a plan to use Akira as bait to lure EDVA to them.
